false_positives: Score disagreements inside the same bucket (Eleanor, Purpose, Rock of Ages, Irma Vep, North by Northwest, Outsiders): the 3-model ensemble of record is unanimous on the bucket, the single-model implied scores differ by 10-20 points only.
Family Album / Behind The Encore 4.7/5 stars at score 90: 4.7/5 is 94%, outside the 5/5 band 91-100 only by rounding; models say 94 and 97. Left at 90, noted as a caveat.
Opening dates earlier than the first review date in 'census-earliest-review-date' shows: pages list first preview, ours is press-night proxy.
Venue wording differences (stage name versus company): The Robert Theatre in the Calderwood Pavilion, Mandell Weiss Theatre, etc. Same buildings.
Pull quotes not verbatim in stored text (17): editorial stitches joined by an em dash or ellipsis across sentences, wording otherwise from the article.
Unknown critic (68): outlets without bylines (Boston Globe wire, Sleepless Critic, Metro Magazine).
caveats: Scapin (ours closes 2026-08-23) and Arcadia (ours 2026-08-09) disagree with David Coddon's 'runs through Aug. 16'; each date was previously set by hand from other review text, sources conflict, shows closed months ago. Left.

21 hub review rows are hand-entered (manualEntry): Black Swan, Wonder, Paranormal Activity, Working Girl. Several differ from the full-text pipeline score (Black Swan Metro 66 vs 76, Working Girl Variety 54 vs 69, San Diego Union-Tribune 62 vs 74). Human scores outrank the pipeline by design; not changed without the owner's call.
Not checked: reviews missing from the cities' main outlets (coverage), and whether the app lists the same shows.
